description: Estimate weight storage at common precisions from tensor shapes. Compare FP32, FP16 and INT8 weight footprints before choosing a device. Static parsing within a 32 MiB combined input budget. No inference, Python imports or pickle execution. Reported compatibility is structural, not a guarantee a framework will load a model. Weight-only estimate. Runtime memory also includes activations, KV cache, allocator overhead and framework state. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.
name: model_memory
title: Estimate model memory
